---
name: Scan problem
about: A printed tag does not scan
labels: scan
---

Scanning is the one thing this project cannot fully control: it depends on a
camera, a light source and two filament colours. The more of this you fill in,
the more useful the report is to everyone else.

**Filament pair**

Body colour and code colour, brand and material.

**Physical size**

Tag width in mm, and the code width in mm if you changed it.

**Phone and app**

Device, operating system version, Spotify app version.

**Lighting**

Daylight, warm indoor, direct spot.

**Does the on-screen preview scan?**

This separates a geometry problem from a print problem.
